proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q f L
  constructor
  · simp only [L, f]
    ring
  · have key : ∀ t u v : ℝ, (∫ x in u..v, (f x - L t x)) = a * ((v - t) ^ 3 - (u - t) ^ 3) / 3 := by
      intro t u v
      have hcongr : (∫ x in u..v, (f x - L t x)) = ∫ x in u..v, a * (x - t) ^ 2 := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x _ => ?_
        simp only [L, f]
        ring
      have hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc u v, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (x - t) ^ 3 / 3) ((x - t) ^ 2) x := by
        intro x _
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x - t) 1 x := (hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const t
        exact ((h1.fun_pow 3).div_const 3).congr_deriv (by norm_num)
      rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x - t) ^ 2).intervalIntegrable u v)]
      ring
    rw [key, key]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q : ℝ), let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c; let L : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun t x => f t + (2 * a * t + b) * (x - t); L p ((p + q) / 2) = L q ((p + q) / 2) ∧ (∫ x in p..((p + q) / 2), (f x - L p x)) + (∫ x in ((p + q) / 2)..q, (f x - L q x)) = a * (q - p) ^ 3 / 12
